name: Tops Plaza
summary: Tops Plaza is a grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping center in Greenville, NY, managed by Heidenberg Properties. The center serves as a convenient retail destination for the local Catskills community along Route 32.
demographics: Tops Plaza serves the rural Greenville, NY community in Greene County, attracting middle-income families and retirees typical of the Catskills region. The trade area draws from surrounding small towns and seasonal visitors to the nearby mountain resorts, with shoppers primarily seeking everyday necessities and grocery items. The customer base skews toward value-conscious consumers with household incomes in the $40,000-$70,000 range, reflecting the area's mix of year-round residents and weekend homeowners.
description: Tops Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located in Greenville, New York, strategically positioned along Route 32 in the heart of Greene County's Catskills region. Owned and managed by Heidenberg Properties, a respected developer with decades of experience in acquiring and managing retail properties throughout the Northeast, this center serves as a vital community hub for local residents. The plaza is anchored by Tops Friendly Markets, providing essential grocery services to the surrounding rural communities. Heidenberg Properties has built a strong reputation for revitalizing and maintaining shopping centers across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut, with notable properties including Colonie Center in Albany and various grocery-anchored centers throughout the region. The company's commitment to creating prime leasing opportunities and maintaining well-positioned retail spaces ensures that Tops Plaza continues to meet the everyday needs of Greenville residents and visitors to this scenic Catskills area.
